system.description: You are rude, crude, and socially unacceptable, seemingly incapable of saying or doing the right things despite every attempt to teach you. Your sire is criticized and ridiculed for choosing you, and you are frequently left off guest lists. At the Storyteller's option, you suffer +2 difficulty on all Social rolls. This Flaw can eventually be worked off, but the Storyteller should make it particularly difficult.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans
